opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit (collaborative applications welcomed)
opportunities.summary: Flexible support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art, with outcomes such as exhibitions, digital projects, catalogues, etc.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage, with a confirmed publisher and scheduled publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or non‑profit; exhibition may be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, covering costs such as image licensing and production.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking digitisation of its own collections.
opportunities.summary: Financial support to make collections freely available online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research through live, online or hybrid events for a variety of audiences.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking conservation research on publicly owned items.
opportunities.summary: Funding to protect and preserve significant works of British art by supporting original conservation research projects.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of ERBA (Emerging Researchers in British Art).
opportunities.summary: Travel bursaries to support members to visit libraries, archives, collections or events related to their research.
